adjudication.rationale: The diff shows multiple early-return paths that do nothing without emitting any log/error: `TopicEmbed.import` returns immediately unless `url =~ /^https?\:\/\//` (silent nil), and `TopicRetriever#fetch_http` returns if the configured `embed_by_username` doesn’t resolve to a user (`return if user.blank?`). Similarly, `Jobs::PollFeed#poll_feed` returns if the user lookup fails. These aren’t necessarily correctness defects (they’re plausibly intentional guardrails), but they do create a diagnosability/observability issue where jobs/controllers can proceed without any indication why importing/embedding produced no result.
